svg.title: Same peptides, two transforms — why VSN can flag "down" where log doesn't
svg.desc: Four panel figure. Panel 1: raw signal boxplots for Control 1, 2, 3 and Test 1, 2, 3, unpaired, with global effect and delta marked. Panel 2, reached by an arrow from panel 1: the same data after VSN, each sample recentered to its own median on a shared line, Test staying wider than Control. Panels 3 and 4, reached by arrows from panels 1 and 2 respectively: 4 example peptides zoomed in, on log and VSN scale.
svg.text: Same peptides, two transforms — why VSN can flag "down" where log doesn't

g.text: Test is more spread out, since peptides respond by different amounts
4 · Zoom in, VSN scale — same 4 peptides

svg.text: Every peptide is higher in Test — all significant
